prompt:
Create ONE native editable SVG opening composition for an original Blindside Night Market story candidate,A Wing Above the Market. Landscape1280x896,viewBox="0 0 1280 896". One scene only,not a card frame,contact sheet,UI or action montage.

One SMALL stylized NIGHTJAR bird perches low/left on a gently curved wooden rail. Reuse the existing Nightjar Joker identity: forest-ink body,one broad muted CORAL folded-wing plane,ochre cheek/head patch and feet,a small pale eye,short dark beak and long descending tapering tail. The bird faces right;its crown,short neck,breast and back connect as a living curved weight-bearing profile,not separate egg/head primitives. Two short attached legs and gripping feet meet the rail naturally. Folded wing overlaps the body from a real shoulder;layer broad feather groups economically,not a fan of detached leaves. No helmet,clothing,extra bird,extra wing or ornamental antlers. The head is quiet and alert at the opening;do not draw later flight poses.

Composition is deliberately WIDE with a small subject and large flight room. Rail runs approximately fromx80,y760 tox535,y720. Bird feet nearx430,y705;head aroundx400,y520,folded body/tail roughlyx330-610,y470-730. These are rough composition anchors,not labels. One face-down playing card with a plain cream border and simple coral back rests stationary on the rail left of the bird,well away from its feet. No visible rank,suit,letter,number or face,no cloth cover or second card. A small ochre crescent moon aroundx1130,y150,radius70 stays far upper-right,OUTSIDE the later flight envelope. Quiet parchment sky and one restrained dark market-rail silhouette;no crowd,buildings clutter,stars or extra props.

The later story will show a small skyward head turn,then one short launch into an open-wing glide right/up. Leave the ENTIRE region roughlyx180-1000,y170-700 open for wing span and travel,including downstroke clearance above/away from the rail. In GIF scale the folded bird is about90x80px,not a giant close-up. Keep margins generous for every future wingtip;do not draw ghost wings,arrows,envelopes or an airborne duplicate now. Card,moon and rail remain static. New watch/card/departure scene is candidate fiction inspired by an existing Joker image,not established game history or a scoring/effect claim.

STYLE: expressive engraved/cut-paper fantasy with broad connected curved/sculptural planes,three readable values,economical curved contours and restrained feather accents. Palette cream#f0e3bf,forest ink#214539,deep ink#18392f,coral#b95746,ochre#bd954c,pale highlight#fff0cd,warm wood#735b3e. Upper-left diffuse print light;matte feather/wood/paper surfaces,no plastic gloss,gradients,dense hatching or tiny repetitive noise. Read at480x336 and160x112. Static self-contained editable SVG paths/simple shapes ONLY. No embedded raster,scripts,external resources,fonts,text,numbers,logos,filters or animation. Separate coherent groups for bird head/body,folded wing,legs/feet,rail,card,moon and quiet sky.
